shopChecks.sub.defaultMessage: Shops go live as soon as they finish setup. Check each one: visit or call, look at the photos and the map pin. Payouts start once a shop is checked.

shopChecks.photos.description: Accessible name of a shop card's photos

shopChecks.check.body.defaultMessage: Nothing changes for the shop's customers. Its payouts can start from the next monthly close. This is recorded with your name.

shopChecks.check.note.description: Check dialog: the note box label

shopChecks.check.noteHelp.defaultMessage: Optional. What you saw, for example "visited, stock and photos match".

shopChecks.reject.body.defaultMessage: The shop is hidden from customers at once. Its open online orders are cancelled, credits go back to the customers and each one is told. Counter sales are not touched. This cannot be undone here.

shopChecks.reject.help.defaultMessage: Say what was wrong. It is recorded with your name, and support uses it if the owner asks.
shopChecks.reject.help.description: Reject dialog: the reason box help

shopChecks.done.reject.defaultMessage: {name} is hidden. {orders, plural, =0 {No open orders.} one {# open order cancelled.} other {# open orders cancelled.}}
